defects.note: a context stored in a struct outlives the call it belonged to; Run should take one
with more jobs than Workers, Run blocks on sem while every worker blocks on the unbuffered send and nobody receives: a deadlock for any real batch
returning while started jobs are still running leaves each of them blocked forever on the unbuffered errs send; drain them or give errs capacity len(jobs)
Run writes p.failed without p.mu while Failed and Snapshot read it under the lock; a concurrent Failed during Run is a data race
Failed hands out the internal slice; a caller's append or sort races with the pool. Snapshot exists for that
out has length 0, so copy copies nothing and Snapshot always returns an empty slice
fn runs with p.mu held, so every Once job in the pool is serialized and a job that calls back into the pool deadlocks
the pause cannot be cancelled; a select on ctx.Done() and a timer can, and the backoff has no jitter
%v drops the chain, so a caller's errors.Is on the last failure is false
a bearer token from math/rand is predictable; crypto/rand
t.Context() is cancelled when the test ends
a sleep-based wait after Run already returned; it proves nothing and slows the suite
workers of 0 or less is accepted, and Run then blocks forever on a semaphore with no capacity
